summary_en: Chuo Warehouse authorized acquisition of up to 770,000 shares (4.3% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 10, 2026 and October 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the board of directors of Chuo Warehouse authorized the acquisition of up to 770,000 treasury shares (4.3% of the 17,783,536 outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 10, 2026 through October 29, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to improve capital efficiency and capital returns while securing growth investment funds needed to adapt to strategic priorities. The company emphasized its commitment to flexible capital allocation and positioning the group to respond to future changes in the business environment through expanded capital policy options.

No ceiling price per share was disclosed. This authorization represents the company's effort to balance strategic investments with improved capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder value over the medium to long term.
